method:
Region-aware base-colour flattening; preserve geometry, UVs and emission bytes.
Regions = coarse SLIC texture segmentation intersected with UV coverage islands,
body-height bands and nearest input-image colour cluster. Palettes are fitted per
region in Lab. Bilateral filtering and local palette compression remove mottling.
Small high-contrast features retain their edges; emissive images are never edited.
Input colour metric: CIE76 distance from each region mean to its assigned input
palette centroid in the same body-height band. This is a palette comparison, not
pixel correspondence or a claim of semantic segmentation accuracy.
rare_hues: Green and blue families get independent input centroids and constrained assignment.
